name: Poco X3

Body.Weight: Poco X3 NFC & Poco X3 Pro: 215 g, Poco X3: 225 g
Body.Other: A-GPS, BDS, GLONASS, NFC (not available on Indian variant), fingerprint (side-mounted), accelerometer, gyroscope, proximity sensor, compass, 3.5mm headphone jack, IR blaster

Platform.Operating system: Original:, Poco X3/NFC: MIUI 12 for Poco based on Android 10, Poco X3 Pro: MIUI 12 for Poco based on Android 11, Current:, Poco X3/Pro: MIUI 13 for Poco based on Android 12, Poco X3 NFC: MIUI 14 for Poco based on Android 12, Poco X3 Pro: MIUI 14 for Poco based on Android 13
Platform.Chipset: Poco X3 and Poco X3 NFC: Qualcomm Snapdragon 732G, Poco X3 Pro: Qualcomm Snapdragon 860
Platform.CPU: 2×2.3 GHz Kryo 470 Gold + 6×1.8 GHz Kryo 470 Silver
Platform.GPU: Poco X3 and Poco X3 NFC: Adreno 618, Poco X3 Pro: Adreno 640

Memory.Storage: Poco X3 and Poco X3 NFC: 64 or 128 GB UFS 2.1, Poco X3 Pro: 128 or 256 GB UFS 3.1

Display.Display: 6.67" 1080 × 2400 pixels IPS LCD, 395 pixels per inch, 120 Hz refresh rate, 240 Hz touch sampling rate, HDR10

Cameras.Rear camera: 64 MP main camera, 1.6 μm 4-in-1 super pixel, 1/1.73" sensor size, PDAF, f/1.89, dual-LED flash, 13 MP ultrawide, 119° angle of view, f/2.2, 2 MP macro, f/2.4, 2 MP depth, f/2.4, LED flash, panorama, HDR, 4K@30fps, 1080p@30/120fps, 720p@960fps, gyro-EIS
Cameras.Front camera: 20 MP, 1.6 μm 4-in-1 super pixel, f/2.2, HDR, panorama, 1080p@30fps

Sound.Sound: Dual stereo speaker, 4cc-equivalent 1012 upper speaker, open cavity, 1cc-equivalent 1216 lower speaker, Maximum speaker vibration amplitude: 0.5 mm, High-resolution audio, Hi-Res audio certification, 3.5mm audio jack

Battery.Battery: Non-removable Li-ion battery (33-watt fast-charging, USB Type-C), Poco X3 NFC and Poco X3 Pro: 5160 mAh, Poco X3: 6000 mAh

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac, dual-band, Wi-Fi Direct, hotspot, Bluetooth v5.1, A2DP, Bluetooth Low Energy, LE, FM radio
